heading: Preemption
lead: Nothing in this subpart 1 is intended to preempt any provision of law of a State or political subdivision of a State that is more restrictive than a provision of this subpart.1

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This subpart, referred to in text, was in the original “this part”, and was translated as reading “this subpart”, to reflect the probable intent of Congress. Pub. L. 114–95 redesignated part C of title IV of Pub. L. 89–10 as subpart 5 of part F of title VIII of Pub. L. 89–10, which is classified to this subpart.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was classified to section 7184 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 114–95.
